purpose: Governed UK air-quality structured-source and monitoring-network coverage registry for SCC/VVIP completeness auditing.
claim_boundary: Registry inclusion documents a known structured source or monitoring network. It does not establish that every station is currently harvested, scientifically comparable, or suitable for regulatory or health conclusions.

coverage_policy.exhaustive_goal: Enumerate every known UK public structured observation source, its station/network inventory, historical availability, access method, quality tier and revision risk.
coverage_policy.completeness_rule: Coverage may be called complete only when every source_system marked required_for_exhaustive has an implemented direct inventory connector or an explicitly reviewed exception, every required national network is enumerated, and station reconciliation reports zero unexplained gaps.
coverage_policy.canonical_evidence_rule: Original provider data and metadata remain canonical. Aggregators and analysis packages may cross-check discovery but cannot replace provider evidence.

quality_tiers.STATUTORY_REFERENCE: National or devolved-government reference/compliance monitoring with formal QA/QC and ratification.
quality_tiers.OFFICIAL_LOCAL: Local-authority or official regional monitoring; quality and method evidence must be checked per station and period.
quality_tiers.LOW_COST_SENSOR: Calibrated sensor observations useful for spatial intelligence but not assumed equivalent to reference methods.
quality_tiers.RESEARCH_SPECIALIST: Research or specialist atmospheric measurements; scientifically valuable but fitness for SCC Air Quality must be assessed per dataset.
quality_tiers.DERIVED_TOOL: Convenience importer, analysis package or aggregator used for discovery/cross-checking only, never canonical evidence.

national_networks.name: UKEAP Acid Gas and Aerosol Network
UKEAP National Ammonia Monitoring Network
notes: Provider narrative and table counts can differ; enumerate live records rather than relying on prose counts.

historical_revision_rules.rule: Do not treat ratification as immutable. Store provider retrieval timestamp, edition/content hash and supersession lineage; reacquire canonical data for each reproducible release.
Track the formal reissue of 2022 and 2023 ammonia results and do not mix withdrawn and revised editions.
Record ozone method/scale metadata around the 1 January 2025 absorption-cross-section change before long-term comparison.
Record instrument family and particle-size range; flag before/after comparisons across the 2023 SMPS replacements.

analysis_tools.name: openair 3 / openairmaps
analysis_tools.role: provider-independent UK network import, station metadata cross-check and established air-quality analysis
analysis_tools.recommended_use: Cross-check AURN, AQE, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland, local networks and LAQN; preserve source-network identity and normalize timestamp semantics.
cautions: openair UK hourly data are date-beginning while some provider portals are date-ending; do not combine without explicit timestamp normalization.

analysis_tools.name: Aeolus
analysis_tools.role: Python multi-network downloader and normalized station schema
analysis_tools.recommended_use: Independent Python cross-check for AURN, SAQN, WAQN, NI, AQE, LAQN, locally-managed monitoring and Breathe London.
cautions: Treat its normalized output as a convenience layer; independently reacquire provider evidence for SCC/VVIP releases.

analysis_tools.name: deweather
analysis_tools.recommended_use: Trend/intervention analysis after observation QA and method-period harmonisation.
cautions: Model output is analytical evidence, not a replacement for observed concentrations or regulatory statistics.

analysis_tools.name: rmweather
analysis_tools.role: Random-forest meteorological normalisation and counterfactual modelling
analysis_tools.recommended_use: Independent sensitivity method for long-term trends and intervention/counterfactual analysis.
cautions: Require held-out diagnostics, stable covariates and explicit uncertainty/limitations.

analysis_tools.name: DuckDB 1.5+ with spatial/GeoArrow support
analysis_tools.role: Local analytical store for station-time observations and geospatial joins
analysis_tools.recommended_use: Parquet/GeoParquet partitioning, reproducible station/time queries, CRS-aware spatial reconciliation and efficient historical analytics.
cautions: Keep raw provider payload hashes and immutable landing zones outside derived analytical tables.

analysis_tools.name: Pandera 0.33+
analysis_tools.role: Executable dataframe/PyArrow schema and data-quality contracts
analysis_tools.recommended_use: Validate pollutant units, timestamps, station identifiers, null policy, ranges, uniqueness, schema drift and Arrow/Parquet handoffs in CI.
cautions: Schema validation establishes structural conformance, not scientific validity.
